passages.text:
# Archival transcript
Written April 23, 1844.
The east depot reported receiving the northern field notebook sent by Iris Beck
in response to the request of April 20, 1844.
Inventory leaf 1. The archive cupboard held a woolen cover beside an unrelated register. No dispatch is recorded here.

# Archival transcript
Written April 23, 1844.
In response to that request of April 20, 1844, I, Iris Beck, sent the northern
field notebook to the east depot.
Inventory leaf 1. The archive cupboard held a woolen cover beside an unrelated register. No dispatch is recorded here.
